framework_rationale: MEDDPICC is the most effective framework for this lead because it involves a high-value industrial mining operation with complex safety and budgetary requirements. While BANT would likely disqualify the lead due to the unconfirmed budget, MEDDPICC allows us to focus on the high-intensity pain and the strategic referral from Anglo American to build a business case.
